designManifest.visualThesis: A mechanism becomes understandable when readers can see decisions and handoffs before reading the explanation.
designManifest.semanticMetaphor: A visible route through decisions, handoffs, and review loops.
designManifest.rhythmPlan: Alternate two diagram anchors with concise structural and reflective pages.
compositionIntent: Make the decision loop visible before introducing explanatory rules.
Turn four editorial actions into a compact working sequence.
Pause on the test that separates a useful diagram from decoration.
Show that a clear explanation advances through explicit handoffs.
Contrast a text-first explanation with a relationship-first explanation.
End with a concise review rule the reader can apply immediately.
designManifest.contrastPlan: Use diagrams on pages one and four, with quieter text-led pages between them.
designManifest.typeStrategy: Serif-led claims with short operational labels and restrained ink-blue emphasis.
designManifest.whyThisVisual: The topic teaches how relationships become legible, so diagrams must demonstrate that claim directly.
designManifest.imageCadence: Diagram-led opening, two text-led explanations, a second diagram anchor, comparison, then a quiet conclusion.
